## Documentation

An on-ramp provider, which sells cryptocurrency for fiat currencies.

### Parameters

- **`id`** (`str`)
  Unique identifier of the provider.

- **`name`** (`str`)
  Name of the provider.

- **`cryptocurrencies`** (List of `str`)
  Cryptocurrencies supported by the provider.

- **`supports_base_currencies`** (`bool`)
  True, if the provider supports base currencies and can be used with
  [`get_on_ramp_provider_base_currencies`](../../methods/wallet/get_on_ramp_provider_base_currencies.md).

- **`supports_limits`** (`bool`)
  True, if the provider supports [`get_on_ramp_payment_limits`](../../methods/wallet/get_on_ramp_payment_limits.md).

- **`supports_quote`** (`bool`)
  True, if the provider supports [`get_on_ramp_payment_quote`](../../methods/wallet/get_on_ramp_payment_quote.md).
